- **Diaporthe**: Mostly stem symptoms with parallel pycnidia rows.
- **White_Mold, Cercospora, Septoria, Fusarium, etc.**: All show clearly different symptoms (leaf spots, white mold growth, root rot) — not matching this pod-focused image.

The uniformly dark reddish-brown dried pods hanging on stems most closely matches the Anthracnose reference, which is known to cause brown pod discoloration at harvest maturity stages.
